segments.title: Station Cold-Open
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the official top-of-hour broadcast sign-on and countdown.

segments.title: Hype Train Subscriber Acknowledgments & Freestyle
segments.notes: Hype Train acknowledges subscribers and launches into extended freestyle raps about piss, shit, and Homer Simpson; claims never to have lied.

segments.title: Chat News Desk
segments.notes: Case reads viewer-submitted stories: Grok AI praising Musk's piss-drinking and blowjob prowess, cyclops cat, Michigan veteran jailed over dog, ShamWow guy campaign video, Twitter location feature exposing MAGA accounts, Slovenian assisted-dying referendum, aristocrat seeking bride.

segments.title: Beardless Case Bit
segments.notes: Alternate-reality beardless Case appears, claims to program spreadsheets, describes a group-sex-based honest economy, and critiques Case's beard.

segments.title: Nvidia RTX 5060 Intern Story
segments.notes: Intern wins GPU at company raffle, pressured to hand it over, quits; story confusingly translated.

segments.title: Olivia Nuzzi / RFK Jr. Sexting Scandal
segments.notes: Vanity Fair reviewing ties to Nuzzi after explicit texts with RFK Jr. surface; Case reads graphic messages including 'drink from me love' and 'I'm a river you are my canyon'.

segments.title: StreamKnockers Game Show Appearance
segments.notes: Case joins Dr. Diggity-Dank and Anxiety Tonight's Twitch knock-based game show: mystery lyrics, trivia, Never Have I Ever, throwdown showdown, interview speedrun; Crum appears as Case's 'full name' answer.

segments.title: Post-Game Show Banter
segments.notes: Crum, Case, Pepito discuss Crum's train-track penis logic, Kendall's texts, Thanksgiving brine tubs, and Crum's high school nickname.

segments.title: How To Make Onionade (Three Ways)
segments.notes: Jeb demonstrates classic, burned-caramelized, and strawberry onionade; Jeb's dad temporarily untethers from the wood; Case blows up Jeb's spot on stream.

segments.title: Worst Wood to Get Stuck In
segments.notes: Crum argues popsicle stick; Munch argues James Woods (Videodrome); segment devolves into popsicle-stick sucking innuendo.

segments.title: Wrap-Up & Raid
segments.notes: Case thanks Dr. Diggity-Dank and Anxiety Tonight, raids Ricky Peacock, discusses Thanksgiving dish ideas with chat and Pepito.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell returns from a week off for a Monday News Blast featuring chat-submitted headlines including Grok AI's explicit praise of Elon Musk, a Michigan veteran jailed over a dog, and the Olivia Nuzzi/RFK Jr. sexting scandal. An alternate-reality beardless Case appears to tout a group-sex-based honest economy. Case guests on the StreamKnockers game show, revealing Crum's foot-fungus cure and variable shoe size. Jeb Nogget demonstrates three onionade recipes while his father's spirit briefly escapes the wood. Munch and Crum close with a debate on the worst wood to get stuck in, descending into popsicle-stick innuendo before a raid on Ricky Peacock.
